dataset: INSPIRE Index Polygons spatial data / WMS view service
resource: Target-specific WMS GetFeatureInfo request around Forge Cottage
data_date: Official HM Land Registry INSPIRE view-service/dataset semantics; target request attempted 2026-10-06
license: UK Open Government Licence (OGL) for INSPIRE Index Polygons

field_evidence.dataset_semantics: HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons represent the position and indicative extent of registered freehold properties in England and Wales and use Land Registry-INSPIRE identifiers related to registered titles.
field_evidence.target_basis: Forge Cottage has the verified producer point POINT (0.910196 51.073494), approximately E=603968.556, N=134491.689 in EPSG:27700; the request uses the same 200 metre target window as the earlier portrayal attempt but a different WMS operation.
field_evidence.request_method: An unused WMS GetFeatureInfo request targets the centre pixel of the bbox with QUERY_LAYERS=inspire:CP.CadastralParcel and INFO_FORMAT=application/vnd.ogc.gml, seeking feature-level information rather than a portrayal image.
field_evidence.transport_result: The exact public/no-login GetFeatureInfo URL could not be opened by the available web transport. A direct network attempt also failed at DNS resolution for inspire.landregistry.gov.uk, so no GML feature response, Land Registry-INSPIRE ID, title-linked identifier, polygon or bbox was returned.
field_evidence.legal_extent_limit: HM Land Registry states that INSPIRE Index Polygons are indicative and do not establish the legal extent contained in a registered title.
field_evidence.parcel_promotion_rule: Without a retrieved target-specific feature response and an authoritative target parcel/title geometry binding, no canonical parcel ID, geometry or bbox is promoted; spatial binding/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
